description: This Java class implements the service for handling account transfer operations such as creating, reversing, and executing fund transfers between savings accounts and loan accounts within the Fineract platform. It includes logic for different transfer scenarios, validation, and transaction management.

classes.name: AccountTransfersWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface for handling account transfer operations, including creation, reversal, and fund transfers. It coordinates between repositories, assemblers, and domain services to perform complex transactional operations related to account transfers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account transfer based on the provided JSON command. Handles different transfer scenarios between savings and loan accounts, manages validation, and records transactions.

methods.name: reverseTransfersWithFromAccountType
methods.description: Reverses all transfer transactions associated with a specific account, identified by account number and type, such as loan accounts.

methods.name: reverseTransfersWithFromAccountTransactions
methods.description: Reverses transfer transactions associated with a collection of transaction IDs, handling batching due to query size limits.

methods.name: reverseAllTransactions
methods.description: Reverses all transfer transactions linked to a specific account ID and type, such as loans.

methods.name: transferFunds
methods.description: Performs a transfer of funds between accounts based on the data in an AccountTransferDTO, handling multiple transfer types including loan payments, deposits, and interest transfers.

methods.name: repayLoanWithTopup
methods.description: Transfers funds from one loan account to another, typically used for loan top-up scenarios, including disbursing and repayments.

methods.name: refundByTransfer
methods.description: Handles refund of overpaid loan amounts by transferring funds from a loan to a savings account, including validation against overpayment.

methods.name: undoTransactions
methods.description: Reverses a list of account transfer transactions, including reversing associated loan and savings transactions, and updates related entities.
